freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 使用邀请链接注册 SenseAudio 开发者账号，在控制台创建 API Key，即可调用 OpenAI 兼容的 S2 系列对话模型与 TTS / ASR 语音接口；平台按 Token 套餐计费，具体可用额度与赠送活动以控制台为准。
freeTierSummary.en: Register a SenseAudio developer account via the invitation link and create an API key to call the OpenAI-compatible S2 chat models plus TTS and ASR endpoints; usage is billed through Token Plans, so check the console for current quotas and promotional credits.
